subject: Hospex: expansion - staging credentials & staggered app enablement
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Fisk <jfisk@hospex.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hospex: expansion - staging credentials & staggered app enablement

Jordan —

Thanks again for the sync this morning. Per our conversation, you’re looking to add three new project teams (Clinical Insights, Scheduling UI, and Analytics) and roughly eight additional apps across those teams. To keep production risk low we recommend a staged enablement with a dedicated staging namespace and per-app API keys that we rotate into production in waves.

High-level proposal (requested action = confirm or adjust):
- Scope: 8 new API keys (one per app), three team namespaces; maintain current Dedicated commit but increase burst capacity by 20% during ramp.
- Timing: staging keys provisioned the week of Nov 16; canary window for first two apps Nov 23–27; full rollout across remaining apps Dec 6–10 (staggered by team).
- Terms: suggested amendment to monthly commit to reflect +20% burst and additional usage floor — I’ve attached a draft amendment.
- Security/compliance: we’ll provide SOC2 evidence and an access audit for the staging namespace; we’ll also support an IP allowlist for the keys during rollout.

Attachments: hospex_provisioning_checklist.xlsx (provisioning steps + owner matrix), hospex_amendment_draft_v1.pdf (commercial + commit language).

Questions for you:
1) Can you confirm the list of apps and primary owners (we captured 8 but want to be precise)?
2) Any hard blackout dates in late Nov/early Dec we should avoid for canary?
3) Who should we work with on procurement for the amendment (name + email)?

Internal: adding Laura to stage the keys and Ben to handle amendment language. Sergio, can you run a short capacity forecast by EOD Monday and confirm whether the +20% burst is sufficient?

If this looks good I’ll: (a) create the staging namespace and pre-provision the keys as placeholders, (b) send the amendment to procurement via DocuSign, and (c) schedule a short runbook walkthrough with the engineering leads.

Thanks —

Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Fisk <jfisk@hospex.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Moss <cmoss@hospex.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hospex: expansion - staging credentials & staggered app enablement

Thanks Jasmine — this is helpful and matches our notes. A few quick items from our side:

- Confirmed apps and tentative owners (we'll send a definitive list by COB Monday):
  • Clinical Insights — Priya Rao
  • Scheduling UI — Dylan (frontend lead)
  • Analytics — Miguel (data platform)
  • +5 smaller microservices that we’ll enumerate
- No major blackout dates the week of Nov 23 but Thanksgiving on Nov 26 is a soft constraint — we'd like the canary started before that.
- Procurement contact: procurement@hospex.com (Claire Moss is the lead on approvals).

Two asks: can you include a short capacity profile (RPS & typical sequence length) for the canary apps so our infra team can model the burst? Also, we will need the SOC2 Type II report and a brief note on data retention for logs from the staging namespace.

We’re good to proceed on the dates you suggested pending the amendment language — please route to procurement and loop me when sent.

—Jordan
Director, Platform Engineering
Hospex Health

I’ll attach a redline version of the amendment once complete.
